g12-ch9-board-01.q: Find the particular solution of $(1+x^2)\dfrac{dy}{dx}=1+y^2$ with $y=1$ at $x=0$.

g12-ch9-board-01.s: Standard form $\frac{dy}{dx}+\frac2xy=x\log x$ [1]; integrating factor $x^2$ [1]. $yx^2=\int x^3\log x\,dx$ [1] $=\frac{x^4\log x}4-\frac{x^4}{16}+C$ [1]. Divide by $x^2$ [1].

alt.q: Find the particular solution of $\dfrac{dy}{dx}+2y\tan x=\sin x$ with $y=0$ at $x=\frac\pi3$.
alt.s: Integrating factor $e^{\int2\tan x\,dx}=\sec^2x$ [1]. $y\sec^2x=\int\sin x\sec^2x\,dx=\sec x+C$ [2]. At $\frac\pi3$: $0=2+C$, so $C=-2$ [1]. $y=\cos x-2\cos^2x$ [1].
